rules.title: No var
rules.check: The var keyword is forbidden. Use const or let.
rules.rationale: var has function scope and hoisting that cause bugs. Block-scoped const/let are safer and clearer.

rules.title: No eval
rules.check: eval and Function constructor are forbidden.
rules.rationale: eval executes arbitrary code, enabling injection attacks. It bypasses static analysis and optimization.

rules.title: No with
rules.rationale: with creates ambiguous scope. It is deprecated, error-prone, and prevents optimization.

rules.title: No arguments Object
rules.check: The arguments object is forbidden. Use rest parameters.
rules.rationale: arguments is not a real array. Rest parameters provide proper array functionality.

rules.title: No == Operator
rules.check: Loose equality (== and !=) is forbidden. Use strict equality (=== and !==).
rules.rationale: Loose equality has complex coercion rules that cause bugs. Strict equality is predictable.

rules.title: No Implicit Globals
rules.check: Implicit global variable creation is forbidden.
rules.rationale: Undeclared variables become globals, polluting global scope. This causes hard-to-find bugs.

rules.title: No Callbacks for Async
rules.check: Callback-based async patterns are forbidden for new code. Use Promises/async-await.
rules.rationale: Callbacks create nesting and make error handling difficult. Promises are the modern standard.

rules.title: No document.write
rules.rationale: document.write blocks parsing and can overwrite the entire document. It causes performance issues.

rules.title: No Synchronous XHR
rules.rationale: Synchronous requests block the main thread, freezing the UI. They are deprecated in modern browsers.

rules.title: No Inline Event Handlers
rules.check: Inline HTML event handlers (onclick, onload, etc.) are forbidden.
rules.rationale: Inline handlers mix behavior with markup. They complicate CSP and cannot be easily managed.

rules.title: No Alert/Confirm/Prompt
rules.check: Browser dialogs (alert, confirm, prompt) are forbidden. Use UI components.
rules.rationale: Browser dialogs block the main thread and cannot be styled. They provide poor UX and break accessibility.

rules.title: No Deep Callback Nesting
rules.check: Callback nesting beyond 2 levels is forbidden. Refactor to promises, async/await, or named functions.
rules.rationale: Deep nesting creates "pyramid of doom" that is hard to read and maintain. It indicates need for refactoring.
